$description: Tier 1 for Vintage, the Triple Feature identity: the brand's raw palette (ADR-0040, ADR-0056; docs repo: design/triple-feature/). Warm ink, bone and dust, with mustard and blood as the two accents. Free-form: other themes name their own. The genre ramps are shared (tokens/primitive/hues.json).

overlay.$description: Hovered and focused rows on raised surfaces. Not in the design's swatches: the step between ink-raised and line that keeps the genre strips at 3:1

default.$description: Borders, dividers, the dashed footer rule (decorative)
Primary text, outlines, light fills, sticker paper
Accent 1: labels, the ticker band, rank tabs, links, utility buttons

blood.$description: Accent 2: large headline text, CTA fills, the match stamp. Darkened from the design's #C8261B so bone text on it passes 4.5:1 (owner, 2026-10-13). About 3.3:1 on ink, so never small text

300.$description: Dislike only: the one red that is readable as small text on ink (ADR-0020). The hue ramps skip red for this reason

heat.$description: The heat ramp: the match sticker's steps between blood (0%) and neon (100%), picked in OKLCH along red → orange → yellow → green at lightnesses where ink text passes 4.5:1 (owner, 2026-10-13).
